items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: One-Eleven was Tudie's, Ed Garland's band.

ctx.x: That wasn't the One-Eleven Band or whatever it was called.
No, you're talking about a taxi dance. One-Eleven was Tudie's, Ed Garland's band.
Well, was Tudie here when you first came in?
